name: Напад на зв’язану фігуру (2)
description: A pin makes a piece temporarily vulnerable because it is tied to an important piece behind it, such as the king or queen. If the pinned piece moves, the piece behind it will be lost. A pin does not always immediately result in material gain. Therefore, it can sometimes be useful to attack the pinned piece again, causing it to be lost.

examples.text: The bishop is pinned and will be lost after Black advances the g-pawn.

texts: Increase the pressure on the pinned piece.
